env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# A comment or string around the argument of len on a const map does not move the call end.
cd m
logos run .
cmp stdout want.txt
logos eject -o out
cd out
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
cmp stdout ../want.txt
cd ../..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/cclencomment

go 1.27

-- m/want.txt --
ok close-paren-comment 2
ok open-paren-comment 2
ok trailing-line-comment 2
ok bare-close-paren-comment 3
ok bare-open-paren-comment 3
ok sum 5
-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

type box struct {
	M map[string]int
	N int
}

const cfg = box{M: map[string]int{"a": 1, "b": 2}, N: 7}

const cm = map[string]int{"x": 1, "y": 2, "z": 3}

func main() {
	n := len(cfg.M /* ) */)
	fmt.Println("ok close-paren-comment", n)
	o := len(cfg.M /* ( */)
	fmt.Println("ok open-paren-comment", o)
	t := len(cfg.M) // )
	fmt.Println("ok trailing-line-comment", t)
	b := len(cm /* ) */)
	fmt.Println("ok bare-close-paren-comment", b)
	c := len(cm /* ( */)
	fmt.Println("ok bare-open-paren-comment", c)
	fmt.Println("ok sum", len(cfg.M /* ) */)+len(cm /* ) */))
}
